typeProperties.script:
parameters{
	hasErrored as boolean (),
	WcfErrorMsg as string ()
}

source(output(
		Date as date,
		SubCategoryId as integer,
		ClientAgentId as integer,
		ClientId as integer,
		ClientLocationId as integer,
		UserId as integer,
		Description as string,
		Namespace as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	isolationLevel: 'READ_UNCOMMITTED',
	query: 'SELECT Date,  SubCategoryId, ClientAgentId, ClientId, ClientLocationId, UserId, Description, Namespace FROM [Staging].[UserDefinedCurveTransform] WHERE [Status]=\'Transformed\' AND CurveId IS NULL GROUP BY  Date,  SubCategoryId, ClientAgentId, ClientId, ClientLocationId, UserId, Description, Namespace',
	format: 'query',
	staged:false) ~> UserDefinedCurveTransform	source(output(
		SubCategoryId as integer,
		CurveDate as date,
		ClientAgentId as integer
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	isolationLevel: 'READ_UNCOMMITTED',
	query: 'SELECT SubCategoryId, CAST(CurveDate AS DATE) AS CurveDate, ClientAgentId FROM Curves.UserDefinedCurve',
	format: 'query',
	staged:false) ~> CheckcurvenotalreadythereLKPTABLE	source(output(
		id as long,
		subCategoryId as integer,
		processId as integer,
		sourceId as integer,
		date as date,
		clientLocationID as integer,
		clientId as integer,
		locked as boolean,
		description as string,
		userId as integer,
		compoundedPeriod as integer,
		created as timestamp,
		updated as timestamp,
		version as string,
		clientAgentId as integer,
		isShared as boolean
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	isolationLevel: 'READ_UNCOMMITTED',
	query: 'select * from Curves.Curve',
	format: 'query',
	staged:false) ~> LookupMDCurveLKPTABLE
UserDefinedCurveTransform sort(asc(Date, false),asc(SubCategoryId, false),asc(ClientAgentId, false),asc(ClientId, false),asc(ClientLocationId, false),asc(UserId, false),asc(Description, false)) ~> Aggregate
UserDefinedCurveTransform sort(asc(Date, false),asc(SubCategoryId, false),asc(Description, false),asc(Namespace, false)) ~> GroupBySubCatandDate
Aggregate window(over(Date,
		SubCategoryId,
		ClientAgentId,
		ClientId,
		ClientLocationId,
		UserId,
		Description),
	asc(Date, true),
	asc(SubCategoryId, true),
	asc(ClientAgentId, true),
	asc(ClientId, true),
	asc(ClientLocationId, true),
	asc(UserId, true),
	asc(Description, true),
	Rank_col = rowNumber()) ~> Aggregatedistinct
GroupBySubCatandDate window(over(Date,
		SubCategoryId,
		Description,
		Namespace),
	asc(Date, true),
	asc(SubCategoryId, true),
	asc(Description, true),
	asc(Namespace, true),
	Rank_col = rowNumber()) ~> GroupBySubCatandDatedistinct
Aggregatedistinct filter(Rank_col == 1) ~> AggregatedistinctFilterComponent
GroupBySubCatandDatedistinct filter(Rank_col == 1) ~> GroupBySubCatandDatedistinctFilterComponent
AggregatedistinctFilterComponent derive(IsShared = true(),
		Created = notConvertedectfunctiondategetdatef(),
		Updated = notConvertedectfunctiondategetdatef()) ~> Constants
GroupBySubCatandDatedistinctFilterComponent derive(ProcessId = 1,
		SourceId = 1,
		Locked = 0,
		IsShared = 0) ~> DerivedColumn
Constants,CheckcurvenotalreadythereLKPTABLE lookup(UserDefinedCurveTransform@SubCategoryId == CheckcurvenotalreadythereLKPTABLE@SubCategoryId && UserDefinedCurveTransform@ClientAgentId == CheckcurvenotalreadythereLKPTABLE@ClientAgentId && Date == CurveDate,
	multiple: false,
	pickup: 'any',
	broadcast: 'none')~> Checkcurvenotalreadythere
DerivedColumn,LookupMDCurveLKPTABLE lookup(UserDefinedCurveTransform@SubCategoryId == LookupMDCurveLKPTABLE@subCategoryId && UserDefinedCurveTransform@Date == LookupMDCurveLKPTABLE@date,
	multiple: false,
	pickup: 'any',
	broadcast: 'none')~> LookupMDCurve
Checkcurvenotalreadythere select(mapColumn(
		IsShared = IsShared,
		Created = Created,
		Updated = Updated,
		Date = Date,
		SubCategoryId = UserDefinedCurveTransform@SubCategoryId,
		ClientAgentId = UserDefinedCurveTransform@ClientAgentId,
		ClientId = ClientId,
		ClientLocationId = ClientLocationId,
		UserId = UserId,
		Description = Description,
		CurveDate = CurveDate
	),
	 skipDuplicateMapInputs: true,
	 skipDuplicateMapOutputs: true) ~> CheckcurvenotalreadythereSelect
LookupMDCurve filter(!isMatch()) ~> FilterLookupMDCurve
CheckcurvenotalreadythereSelect filter(!isMatch()) ~> FilterCheckcurvenotalreadythere
FilterLookupMDCurve sink(input(
		date as date 'dd-MM-yyyy',
		sourceId as integer,
		processId as integer,
		description as string,
		subCategoryId as integer,
		locked as boolean,
		isShared as boolean
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	stagingSchemaName: 'dbo',
	saveOrder: 10000,
	insertable:true,
	deletable:false,
	upsertable:false,
	updateable:false,
	keys:[],
	mapColumn(
		date = Date,
		sourceId = SourceId,
		processId = ProcessId,
		description = Description,
		subCategoryId = SubCategoryId,
		locked = Locked,
		isShared = IsShared)) ~> OLEDBDestination
FilterCheckcurvenotalreadythere sink(input(
		Description as string,
		IsShared as boolean,
		Updated as timestamp 'dd-MM-yyyy',
		UserId as integer,
		SubCategoryId as integer,
		ClientId as integer,
		CurveDate as timestamp 'dd-MM-yyyy',
		ClientAgentId as integer,
		ClientLocationID as integer,
		Created as timestamp 'dd-MM-yyyy'
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	stagingSchemaName: 'dbo',
	saveOrder: 10000,
	insertable:true,
	deletable:false,
	upsertable:false,
	updateable:false,
	keys:[],
	mapColumn(
		Description,
		IsShared,
		Updated,
		UserId,
		SubCategoryId,
		ClientId,
		CurveDate = Date,
		ClientAgentId,
		ClientLocationID = ClientLocationId,
		Created)) ~> UserDefinedCurve
